Electronic Equipment Insurance (EEI)

Your business runs on technology—from servers and laptops to specialized machinery and mobile devices. But what happens when critical equipment fails due to accidental damage, electrical surges, or theft?

This is when Electronic Equipment Insurance (EEI) becomes handy as it ensures that your operations don’t skip a beat.

At TRINITY, we offer a comprehensive Electronic Equipment Insurance that covers the following:
• All risk of sudden and unforeseen physical loss
• Damage due to fire/lightning, windstorm, typhoon, earthquake, tidal wave, explosion, smoke damage
• Robbery, burglary, and theft
• Mechanical breakdowns, short circuiting, and other electrical causes
• Business interruption
• Negligence and accidental dropping

What is the information needed for Electronic Equipment Insurance?
• Assured's Name
• Address
• Nature of Business
• Territorial/Geographical Limits (for mobile equipment)
• List of electronic equipment to be insured
• Sum insured
• Broker of Record (BOR) - form will be provided by Trinity
• KYC form – form will be provided by Trinity
